title: Not for Mr. Coffee as a replacement
text:
Not for Mr. Coffee as a replacement. I was hoping this would fit my Mr. Coffee (programmable) coffee maker, however it was a bit too tall. I ended up returning it. It did have options for different lids however neither worked.

I am leaving this review in case someone else is looking for a Mr. Coffee replacement carafe (and like me, in hopes it would fit).
